# robots.txt optimized for AEO (template: adapt before publishing)

# Add Disallow only for paths that exist on this site. Do not block routes used
# to render the page (e.g. /api/ that feeds a SPA) or the og image (e.g. /api/og).
# robots.txt is public and protects nothing: private areas need a login or noindex.
